newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RBA leaves Australian rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RBA leaves Australian rates unchanged.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia left Australian interest rates unchanged at its first opportunity to announce any such change afte Tuesday's Board meeting.
Any change in monetary policy settings is announced at 9.30 a.m. (2330 GMT), when the RBA releases its dealing intentions for the day, and there was no announcement made today.
Interest rates were last lowered on July 31, when they were cut by 0.5 percentage points to 7.00 percent. Economists, and the market, expect another cut in rates by year-end.

A cut today was seen as only an outside chance, with most believing the cut will occur after third quarter inflation and wages data is released later this month, or after the RBA Board next meets on November 5.
